name: Donchian breakout
description: Buy a new 20-day high, exit on a 10-day low. The rules made famous by the Turtle traders.

about.how_it_works: A close above the highest high of the previous 20 days means the market just broke out of its recent range. Breakouts that start a big trend pay for the many that fail. The trade exits when price closes below the previous 10-day low, giving the trend room to breathe.
about.works_best: Markets that trend hard after breaking out, on daily charts.
about.fails_when: False breakouts: price pokes above the range and falls back. Expect a low win rate (often 30 to 40%) with a few large winners.
